steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Get'cher ass on the ground!

steps.name: A-Zone Prisoner
steps.text: Gah, sleaze...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Waaait, whoah, what even happened? Why're we duking it out now?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Thought I told you to go hide, Kafka. Whaddaya over here for?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Aw, gawd, I'm fine. Just tell me what's going on, and make it slick.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Hah, just take a look. Infected and Non-Infected don't see eye to eye most times, hey? So we split into two sides and brawl.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I mean, yeah, that happens for sure, but the jailers don't care?!

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Well, I want you to look at them careful.

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: *Clicks tongue* Sure do love a good inmate fight.

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: We hit the jackpot with today's shift.

steps.name: Jailer B
steps.text: Hahah, right you are.

steps.name: Jailer B
steps.text: This is the moment. The only joy working in this hellhole.

steps.name: Jailer B
steps.text: Get their asses, A-Zoners! I'm watchin' you!

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: You see that? They're living it up like no one else here.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Plus, the side that wins gets slightly better eats for the next while.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: So this is all their fun? What's stopping us from just not fighting?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Not fighting? Kafka, you know how I got slammed up?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Took the scruff of everyone who looked down on me, and I socked 'em!

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Hey, Kafka. I reckon, all the places in the goddamn world, this is the only one where you can bust Non-Infected jaws and the fuzz can't even be assed to slap you on the wrist.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Beat someone to death? You get locked in for a while.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Besides, if you're really gonna die, you're gonna die. Who's scared of that in prison?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Beh, I'm done. You get it. I'm gonna go back and make hay. You find somewhere and stay low!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Beh yourself. You're lookin' down on Kafka, you know.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: But man. I guess the Infected and the Non-Infected still live the same old clash in here.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Not just living it, even. Idea's gone mutant. Supermutant.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I've seen a thing or two outside, but I've gotta admit, if this ain't a first for me... If Silence was watching this, she'd be sick to the bone.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: But sorry, Silence, 'cause I'm different. Heheh.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Messier the sitch gets, the more I like it.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You fight your thing, and I'll go see what pies I can't get my fingers in. That gets me ready for the next bit...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yeuch, who sneaked their leftovers out for a box lunch?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Why's there a sock here...?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I guess that's what you get in a real prison. Y'all do what you're meant to, huh. Not finding anything I could really use though...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Buuut...

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner
steps.text: Drop dead, dirtbag!

steps.name: A-Zone Prisoner
steps.text: Drop dead yourself!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Ooh, they're going at it. And the long-timers here don't play fair, either. They've been making all sortsa weapons on the down low.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Come on, get madder. Then drop something for me. Heheh.
Ngh!

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner
steps.text: I got a stray one here, heh-heh-heh...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Aw, nerts, that girl's in trouble!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Maybe I oughta go help...

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner
steps.text: Heh, heh...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Oops. She was hiding something up her sleeve, looks like. Interesting, interesting...
What's going on here?!

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Superintendent Barton, sir! The prisoners are fighting!

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: And you're sitting there watching? You ain't stoppin' them?

steps.name: Jailer B
steps.text: Oh, Superintendent. Time's up?

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: I don't give a hoot which way the time is, it's our duty as jailers to manage the prisoners!

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Jailer A
steps.text: Hey, you lot! Superintendent says it's time to quit it!

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoners
steps.text: *Columbian slang*

steps.name: A-Zone Prisoners
steps.text: *Columbian dialect*

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Urgh. I've said it before and I'll say it again. This is prison. Not your consarned battlefield.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Y'all should be workin' proper. Actin' proper. Only way your moms, pops 'n' buds out there'll see you a day sooner. You hear me?

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: I'm tellin' you this for your own good...

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Tch. Here we go again.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Wow, there's a couple marks on you. Y'alright?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Right as rain. Scratches! And I got to smash in a few A-Zone dirtbags for the trouble. Heheh, fine deal to me!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: And it winds down like this every time?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: You mean Barton?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Yeah, more or less. He's the jailers' Super. Always shows up at times like these, puts on the vaudeville and hits the brakes. Then says some meaningful crap.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Especially moments like now when the place's stopped over at a city, the warden's gone and he acts like he's lord of the prison.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Dropped on his head as a kid.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: But it ain't every time this happens, I'll tell you that.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Plenty of times it don't stop for nothin'... I'd say most of the time, actually. Not that often it's over when over says, like today.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: But when it just won't end, you'll see Barton call in his safety.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: His what?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Yup. There he is.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Anthony?!

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Looks like you really do know him.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I mean, I've only seen him all dressed up before...

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: You oughta learn from Mr. Anthony's example here.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: He might be a prisoner, but he esteems rationality, and he does not make his first resort violence. In his downtime, he likes to read. Write. Listen to records. Mighty fine boy!

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Bleuch.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You don't like Anthony?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: No, no, no, don't get me wrong, Kafka.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Ain't no-one in this prison who'd cross Anthony.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Usually, he's just like Barton said. Good to other folks. But we all know he's the biggest, muscliest goddamn shot in this place.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: They say when he came into prison, first thing he did was go and beat every last guy in C-Zone into line.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Damn right. And anyone else from C-Zone barely gets to meet us, but he's the real thing. Swell as a bell. A-Zone or B-Zone, everyone falls in with him.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Yeah. I'm just barfing having to look at Barton.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Listen to him. You think he's praisin' Anthony right now? He's mocking him.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Anthony's the only guy he can't lift his head against, but he needs Anthony to wrangle us, so this is the only way he can do it.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: We are Mansfield State Prison. State! Prison. We are a pilot penitentiary with special approval from the capital. We will serve as a shining example to the other states.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner B
steps.text: Tch. We're a crowd of convicts. Example your face...

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: In short, I hope you can now reflect on yourselves. Reflect for my sake!

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Let's go, Anthony. You've got an hour of hittin' the books today.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: So usually you don't even see Anthony?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Usually, I guess?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Timetabling for the serious offenders is outta step with ours, and most of the time they're just staying in the C-Zone tower.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: What, you wanna see him?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Mayhaps I do.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I wanna talk about something with him. Obviously, not something the jailers can know about.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Don't worry, I get'cha. If you wanna have a little heart-to-heart with him, it's not like you don't have a shot...
